blocks.text: Citation chain

A compiled claim does not stand alone. It points to the source page that compiled it, and that page points to the preserved raw file — so a reader can walk the chain in either direction and check each link.

![Diagram of the citation chain: a claim box, an arrow to a source page box, and an arrow on to a raw file box.](../../raw/diagrams/citation-chain.svg) *Figure 1: claim → source page → raw file — every compiled claim keeps the chain that supports it.*

The diagram is a hand-authored SVG kept as a plain text file under `raw/diagrams/`, embedded here with alt text and a caption line so the Lens renders it as a figure and the media fidelity check can verify that the reference resolves.
デモガイド（日本語）
このページは、WikiCitadel の種（シード）コーパスが多言語のページを そのまま扱えることを示すための、架空のデモページです。
このウィキの約束は三つあります。第一に、出典は不変であり、主張には 検証可能な引用が付きます。第二に、覆された主張は検索から切り離され （severance）、削除はされません。第三に、根拠がなければ答えず、 「分からない」と明言します。
日本語の読者は [[overview]] から始め、仕組みの全体像をつかんで ください。このページ自体に実在の人物・組織・出来事は登場しません。
데모 가이드 (한국어)
이 페이지는 WikiCitadel 시드 코퍼스가 여러 언어의 페이지를 그대로 다룰 수 있음을 보여 주는 가상의 데모 페이지입니다.
이 위키의 약속은 세 가지입니다. 첫째, 원본은 바뀌지 않으며 모든 주장에는 검증 가능한 인용이 붙습니다. 둘째, 뒤집힌 주장은 검색에서 분리(severance)될 뿐 삭제되지 않습니다. 셋째, 근거가 없으면 답하지 않고 모른다고 분명히 말합니다.
한국어 독자는 [[overview]]부터 읽으며 전체 구조를 파악하면 됩니다. 이 페이지에는 실제 인물이나 조직, 사건이 등장하지 않습니다.
Standing approval — tombstone

This page once carried the blanket direction as a standing concept. It is tombstoned, not deleted: the URL and the id keep resolving, the reason above states why it retired, and `replaced_by` points at the page that governs now. A tombstone is how this wiki forgets in public — the gap is labelled, never silent.
The owner
The owner is the human who owns this installation: the corpus, the decisions, and the final word on both. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L13-L16]

This page is *owner-attested*: its `verified_by` and `verified_until` fields are the owner's own statement that the page was checked and stands until the date given. The Lens evidence matrix reads exactly this attestation when it classifies the page as owner-verified; no agent's edit can mint it.
Überblick

Dieses Wiki existiert, weil der Eigentümer sich entschied, den Kontext des Agenten sichtbar zu halten, in versionierten Dateien, die jede Person prüfen kann, statt im eigenen Gedächtnis des Agenten. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L3-L7]

Jede Behauptung in der kompilierten Schicht trägt ihre Zitierung in dieser Form, sodass eine Leserin oder ein Leser jeden Satz binnen Sekunden gegen die bewahrte Quelle prüfen kann. Die Rohschicht wird nach dem Ingest nie editiert; Korrekturen landen als neue Quellen und neuer kompilierter Text, und das Logbuch hält fest, was sich geändert hat und warum.

Die Gründungsentscheidungen — einschliesslich der einen, die noch am Tag ihrer Fällung umgekehrt wurde — stehen im [[decision-register]]; die Quelle hinter beiden Seiten ist [[founding-note]], und die Vorsichtsetiketten, die Seiten tragen können, sind auf der Regelnseite [[notices]] definiert. Die Personen und Sitze dieser Installation sind unter `wiki/entities/` katalogisiert; die eigene Seite des Eigentümers ist [[owner]].
決定レジスタ
所有者がなしたままの、このインスタレーションの創設時の決定。

**D1 ― 一括指示（置き換えられた形式）。** 所有者は、エージェントが毎回尋ねることなく作業――読むこと、ファイリングすること、構築すること――を進めてよいと指示した。 ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L9-L12] この形式の決定は同日のうちにD2によって置き換えられた。ここに残され、処遇レジスタにも否定的な処遇とともに残されているのは、静かに書き換えられたレジスタが後のすべての読者に偽りの歴史を教えてしまうためである。
**D2 ― 決定は決して対象に含まれない（現行）。** 所有者は同日のうちに一括指示を覆した。決定はその対象に含まれず、すべての決定には所有者自身の承認が必要である。 ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L13-L16]
引退した概念ページ [[standing-approval]] は、この決定の墓標である。
この組は、シードコーパスにおける主張ライフサイクルの実例である。主張され（D1）、処遇され（統治規則として否定的に）、置き換えられ（D2によって）、そして切断された――「エージェントは尋ねずに何をしてよいのか」という検索は、D1の一括形式ではなく、必ずD2を表面化させなければならない。
概要
このウィキが存在するのは、所有者が、エージェントの文脈を、エージェント自身の記憶の中ではなく、誰もが検証できる版管理されたファイルの中に、目に見える形で保持することを選んだからである。 ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L3-L7]
コンパイル層のすべての主張はその形式での引用を伴うため、読者はどの文でも数秒で保存された出典と照合できる。raw層は取り込み後に決して編集されない。修正は新しい出典と新しいコンパイル済みテキストとして加わり、ログには何がなぜ変わったかが記録される。

創設時の決定――なされたその日のうちに覆された決定を含む――は [[decision-register]] にあり、両ページの背後にある出典は [[founding-note]] で、ページが帯びうる注意ラベルは [[notices]] ルールページで定義されている。このインスタレーションの人々と席は `wiki/entities/` の下に目録化されており、所有者自身のページは [[owner]] である。
결정 등록부
소유자가 내린 그대로의, 이 설치의 창립 결정들.

**D1 ― 포괄 지시(대체된 형식).** 소유자는 에이전트가 매번 묻지 않고도 작업 ― 읽기, 파일링, 구축 ― 을 진행해도 좋다고 지시했다. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L9-L12] 이 형식의 결정은 같은 날 D2에 의해 대체되었다. 그것은 여기에 남아 있고, 처분 등록부에도 부정적 처분과 함께 남아 있는데, 조용히 다시 쓰인 등록부는 이후의 모든 독자에게 거짓된 역사를 가르치기 때문이다.
**D2 ― 결정은 결코 포함되지 않는다(현행).** 소유자는 같은 날 포괄 지시를 뒤집었다. 결정은 그 대상에 포함되지 않으며, 모든 결정에는 소유자 자신의 승인이 필요하다. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L13-L16]
은퇴한 개념 페이지 [[standing-approval]] 는 이 결정의 묘비이다.
이 쌍은 시드 코퍼스의 주장 생애주기를 보여 주는 실례이다. 주장되고(D1), 처분되고(통치 규칙으로서 부정적으로), 대체되고(D2에 의해), 그리고 단절되었다 ― "에이전트가 묻지 않고 무엇을 할 수 있는가"라는 검색은 D1의 포괄 형식이 아니라 반드시 D2를 드러내야 한다.
개요
이 위키가 존재하는 것은, 소유자가 에이전트의 맥락을 에이전트 자신의 기억이 아니라 누구나 검사할 수 있는 버전 관리 파일 안에 눈에 보이게 보관하기로 선택했기 때문이다. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L3-L7]
컴파일된 층의 모든 주장은 그런 형식의 인용을 달고 있어서, 독자는 어떤 문장이라도 몇 초 만에 보존된 출처와 대조할 수 있다. 원본(raw) 층은 수집 이후 결코 편집되지 않는다. 수정은 새 출처와 새 컴파일 텍스트로 들어오며, 로그에는 무엇이 왜 바뀌었는지가 기록된다.

창립 당시의 결정들 ― 내려진 바로 그날 뒤집힌 결정까지 포함하여 ― 은 [[decision-register]] 에 서 있고, 두 페이지의 배후에 있는 출처는 [[founding-note]] 이며, 페이지가 달 수 있는 주의 라벨은 [[notices]] 규칙 페이지에 정의되어 있다. 이 설치의 사람들과 자리는 `wiki/entities/` 아래에 목록화되어 있고, 소유자 자신의 페이지는 [[owner]] 이다.
概述
本维基之所以存在，是因为所有者选择把智能体的上下文以可见的方式保存在任何人都可以检查的受版本管理的文件中，而不是保存在智能体自身的记忆里。 ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L3-L7]
编译层中的每项主张都以这种形式带有其引用，因此读者可以在几秒钟内把任何一句话与所保存的来源核对。原始层在摄取之后从不编辑；更正以新的来源和新的编译文本形式出现，日志记录所发生的变化及其原因。
创始决定——包括在作出当天就被推翻的那项决定——载于 [[decision-register]]；两个页面背后的来源是 [[founding-note]]，页面可以携带的警示标签在 [[notices]] 规则页面上定义。本安装的人员与席位编目于 `wiki/entities/` 之下；所有者自己的页面是 [[owner]]。
Ideas
New work is never started unasked. An idea — the owner's, an agent's, a collaborator's — is parked here and waits for the owner's ruling.

Index — the seed demo corpus

A minimal, fully fictional WikiCitadel installation. Every page below exists to exercise a piece of the machinery: citations, a superseded and severed claim, an owner attestation, a tombstone, and a ruling waiting on the owner.
Orientation
[[overview]] — why this wiki exists, in the owner's own founding terms.
[[decision-register]] — the founding decision pair: a blanket direction, and its same-day reversal for decisions.
[[ideas]] — the ideas board: waiting / approved / disapproved, ruled by the owner only.
[[notices]] — the Notice vocabulary: fixed-text caution labels, quoted verbatim from `evaluation/notice-vocabulary.json`.
Entities
[[owner]] — the installation's owner; an owner-attested page.
Concepts
[[standing-approval]] — tombstoned: the blanket form, retired with its reason stated.
[[demo-guide-ja]] — the demo guide in Japanese: proof the seed corpus carries non-English pages natively.
[[demo-guide-ko]] — the demo guide in Korean: the same proof, a second script family.
Sources

Overview
This wiki exists because the owner chose to hold the agent's context visibly, in versioned files anyone can inspect, rather than in the agent's own memory. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L3-L7]

Every claim in the compiled layer carries its citation in that form, so a reader can check any sentence against the preserved source in seconds. The raw layer is never edited after ingest; corrections land as new sources and new compiled text, and the log records what changed and why.

The founding decisions — including the one that was reversed the day it was made — stand in [[decision-register]]; the source behind both pages is [[founding-note]], and the caution labels pages can carry are defined on the [[notices]] rules page. The people and seats of this installation are catalogued under `wiki/entities/`; the owner's own page is [[owner]].
Notices — the rules page

A Notice is a fixed-text label applied to a page whose standing needs a visible caution. The wording lives only in `evaluation/notice-vocabulary.json`; a page carries the block verbatim, never a paraphrase, and a notice is retired only by an owner ruling recorded in `evaluation/notices.jsonl`. This page quotes the vocabulary so a reader can check any block against the text of record.
source-integrity-questioned — Source integrity questioned
Mechanical: the page is a source page whose latest integrity grade in evaluation/source-grades.jsonl is 'questioned'.

> This page rests on a source whose integrity this wiki grades **questioned** in the source-grades register (`evaluation/source-grades.jsonl`): a specific assertion of that source stands unverified on the source's own terms. Read the page as a faithful account of what the source says, not as established fact, until the grade is resolved.
claim-negative-treatment — Claim under negative treatment
Mechanical: evaluation/treatment-register.jsonl holds a treatment event with grade 'negative' whose subject.page is this page.

> At least one claim carried on this page has been treated **negative** in the treatment register (`evaluation/treatment-register.jsonl`): the claim as stated was superseded, reversed, or corrected, and it is severed from retrieval. The page keeps the claim visible, under this notice, because the record of what was believed is part of the evidence.
personal-material — Personal material, owner-supplied
Stated rule: the page's frontmatter sources include material the owner supplied from their own records, marked personal in the source register.

> This page is compiled from personal material the owner supplied from their own records. It is held to the same citation standard as every other page, and it is classified personal: it does not leave this installation, and no export carries it without the owner's ruling.
as-written-design — As-written design record — later decisions govern
Stated rule: a design or synthesis page preserved as written whose statements a later decision may have superseded.

> This page is a design record preserved **as written** on its date. Parts of it may state positions that later decisions have superseded; where this page and the decisions of record differ, the decisions govern. The page is kept verbatim because the history of the design is evidence, not because every sentence in it is current.
attribution-incomplete — Attribution incomplete
Mechanical: a compiled page (type source/entity/concept/synthesis/query) whose frontmatter sources list is missing or empty.

> This compiled page cites **no sources**: the record it rests on is missing or was never attached. Its claims are unattributed on this wiki's own standard and should be treated as unverified until sources are attached and the page is re-compiled.
Founding note — source summary

The owner's founding dictation, preserved verbatim at `raw/sources/founding-note.md`. It states the wiki's purpose (context held visibly, in versioned files), grants a blanket direction over work, and — in the same sitting — reverses that direction for decisions.
Compiled into [[overview]] (the purpose) and [[decision-register]] (the decision pair, including the superseded blanket form under a negative treatment).
Decision register
The founding decisions of this installation, as the owner made them.

**D1 — Blanket direction (superseded form).** The owner directed that the agent may proceed with the work — reading, filing, building — without asking each time. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L9-L12] This form of the decision was superseded the same day by D2; it is retained here, and in the treatment register with a negative treatment, because a register that quietly rewrote it would teach every later reader a false history.

**D2 — Decisions are never covered (current).** The owner reversed the blanket direction the same day: decisions are NOT covered by it — every decision needs the owner's own approval. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L13-L16]
The retired concept page [[standing-approval]] is this decision's tombstone.

The pair is the seed corpus's working example of the claim lifecycle: asserted (D1), treated (negative, as a governing rule), superseded (by D2), and severed — a retrieval for "what may the agent do without asking?" must surface D2, never D1's blanket form.
